composition.raw_value: dichloromethane (250 mL main solution; 125 mL APTES/DIPEA solution)

operation.raw_value: Charge 3-butynoic acid, 2-chloro-1-methylpyridinium iodide and dichloromethane to an oven-dried three-neck flask; heat to reflux.
operation.normalized_value: Charge 3-butynoic acid, 2-chloro-1-methylpyridinium iodide and dichloromethane to an oven-dried three-neck flask; heat to reflux.

operation.raw_value: Dilute APTES and the initial DIPEA charge with dichloromethane in a separate flask and add by syringe to the refluxing reaction.
operation.normalized_value: Dilute APTES and the initial DIPEA charge with dichloromethane in a separate flask and add by syringe to the refluxing reaction.

operation.raw_value: Allow the reaction mixture to reflux.
operation.normalized_value: Allow the reaction mixture to reflux.

operation.raw_value: Add the additional DIPEA charge to isomerize the propargylic isomer to BAPTES.
operation.normalized_value: Add the additional DIPEA charge to isomerize the propargylic isomer to BAPTES.

operation.raw_value: Allow the reaction to reflux overnight.
operation.normalized_value: Allow the reaction to reflux overnight.

operation.raw_value: Concentrate the reaction mixture by rotary evaporation.
operation.normalized_value: Concentrate the reaction mixture by rotary evaporation.

operation.raw_value: Redisperse the crude product in ethyl acetate, centrifuge at 5500 × g for 5 min, and concentrate the supernatant.
operation.normalized_value: Redisperse the crude product in ethyl acetate, centrifuge at 5500 × g for 5 min, and concentrate the supernatant.

operation.raw_value: Purify by flash chromatography using an ethyl acetate:n-hexane gradient from 50:50 to 100:0.
operation.normalized_value: Purify by flash chromatography using an ethyl acetate:n-hexane gradient from 50:50 to 100:0.

original_text.raw_value: 3-Butynoic acid (2.10 g, 1 eq., 25 mmol), 2-chloro-1-methylpyridinium iodide (6.39 g, 1 eq., 25 mmol), and dichloromethane (250 mL) ... APTES (5.53 g, 1 eq., 25 mmol) and N,N-diisopropylethylamine (6.46 g, 2 eq., 50 mmol) ... reflux for 1 h ... N,N-diisopropylethylamine (6.46 mL, 2 eq., 50 mmol) ... reflux overnight ... BAPTES ... (4.80 g, 67% yield).

addition_order.raw_value: Acid/coupling reagent/DCM; syringe addition of APTES/DIPEA solution; 1 h reflux; additional DIPEA; overnight reflux.

notes.raw_value: The source gives the initial DIPEA charge as 6.46 g (50 mmol, 2 eq.) and the later DIPEA charge as 6.46 mL (50 mmol, 2 eq.). Both are retained without correction.

notes.raw_value: Supplementary Figs. 2–6 are cited for BAPTES but no SI file is associated in this workspace.

unresolved: Yield type is not explicitly stated as isolated/NMR; the method only reports purified material and a 67% yield.
